playerTransientCleanup.implementation: transient Battle Context is discarded only after V4.21 final-exit commit

petTransientCleanup.implementation: Transient pet battle state is discarded with Battle Context; Persistent pet data only receives source-closed HP cleanup through V4.21.

ridePet.behavior: when CHAR_WORKPETFALL is set, fixed-C clears ride marker to -2, sends status, then normalizes to -1
ridePet.policy: not synthesized because canonical Persistent State has no source-closed ridePetId/ride status

becomePig.behavior: when enabled for Player under _PETSKILL_BECOMEPIG, fixed-C restores base image and compliance on final exit
becomePig.policy: not synthesized because current Persistent State has no source-closed image/BecomePig lifecycle field

statusSend.petStatus: CHAR_K_STRING_* status payload is transient network output
statusSend.policy: network sends are not represented as persistent mutations

closureRule: No persistent field is invented for transient Exit cleanup; clearing the in-memory Battle Context after final commit is the canonical Browser teardown.
